evals.prompt: 看看我的 pi agent 技能使用情况
evals.expected_output: Run the audit script, produce a categorized report (high/medium/low/unused), and summarize findings for the user.
expectations: The skill runs scripts/audit.py via uv run
The output includes at least 3 categories (high/medium/low/unused)
The output lists specific skill names with their usage counts
The output provides a summary of used vs unused skills

evals.prompt: 整理技能，看看哪些可以删掉
evals.expected_output: Identify unused skills from the audit, read their SKILL.md descriptions, suggest which to remove with rationale.
expectations: The skill runs the audit script to identify unused skills
The skill reads SKILL.md of at least 2 unused skills to explain their purpose
The skill provides removal commands (bunx skills remove)
The skill asks for user confirmation before suggesting removal

evals.prompt: 看下 kami 和 write 这两个技能用的多不多
evals.expected_output: Look up usage counts for specific skills (kami, write) from the audit data and report whether they are used or unused.
expectations: The skill runs the audit script
The skill specifically mentions the requested skills (kami, write)
The skill explains what each skill does (reads their SKILL.md)
The skill gives a recommendation (keep or remove) for each
